scripts.test:db:up: uv run --with-requirements apps/api/requirements.txt --with pytest python scripts/test_postgres.py up
scripts.test:db:down: uv run --with-requirements apps/api/requirements.txt --with pytest python scripts/test_postgres.py down
scripts.test:db:reset: uv run --with-requirements apps/api/requirements.txt --with pytest python scripts/test_postgres.py reset
scripts.test:python: uv run --with-requirements apps/api/requirements.txt --with pytest python scripts/test_postgres.py test
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:python
